source.extractionNote: Every set's API, variants, defaults and the Table's shape bindings re-verified against Figma; structure and intent verbatim from the 2026-10-31 spec, which they match.

summary: A data table with rows of content in columns, framed by an optional controls bar above and a footer below. It can select and count rows, sort, search, filter and page them, resize, show, hide and freeze columns, and open a compact actions menu per row. The controls bar, content and footer are exposed, so their own properties are set from Table.

intent.true: Shows the controls bar above the content, holding the search field and the controls slot. Turn it off when the table doesn't need its own search or extra actions above it.
intent.false: Removes the controls bar entirely, the content starts at the top of the table.

intent.true: Shows the footer below the content, holding the page summary text and the pagination control. Turn it off for a table short enough that pagination has nothing to do.
intent.false: Removes the footer entirely, the content ends at the bottom of the table.

controls: cells (Button, Checkbox shape; Status Label rounded)

intent.rounded: Every component inside the table takes its rounded option: search, buttons, checkboxes, status labels and pagination, including the table's own corners.
intent.sharp: Every component inside the table takes its sharp option.

intent.true: Adds the selection column: select-all in the header and a checkbox per row.
Adds a trailing more button per row that opens a compact menu of the row's actions.

intent.false: The content grows with its rows.
intent.true: Caps the content height so rows scroll under a sticky header.
An info Label at the start of the controls bar counts the selected rows. It shows only while rows are selected.
A settings button at the end of the controls bar opens the column panel to show, hide and freeze columns.
A small compact Select after the page summary sets how many rows each page shows.

States live on the private cells: _Header Cell (enabled, hover, focus, disabled; resize none, hover, focus), _Data Cell (enabled, hover, selected, disabled), _Select Cell (checked false, indeterminate, true; disabled), _Actions Cell (enabled, open, selected, disabled), _Label (enabled, disabled; filtered), _Avatar and text (enabled, disabled), _Sort (default, hover, disabled).

behavior.description: No transition is defined for the controls bar or the footer appearing and disappearing.
A checkbox per row and select-all in the header. Select-all covers the enabled rows shown and is indeterminate while only some are selected. Selected rows take the selected fill across every column.
While rows are selected, an info Label at the start of the controls bar counts them. Screen readers hear the count change.
A sortable header cycles none, ascending and descending. Client-side, the table reorders the rows itself; otherwise the consumer does.
Search matches every cell's text. A filterable header opens a compact checkbox menu of the column's values, and a filtered column keeps its glyph in foreground/cursor.
Rows per page sets the page size. Client-side, the summary and page count are worked out, and sorting, searching or filtering returns to page 1.

Hovering a header's trailing edge shows the neutral hover border at full cell height. Dragging trades width with the next resizable columns, so the table width never changes. Arrow keys step it and a double-click resets it.
The settings panel shows or hides columns and freezes up to a chosen column. The last column showing can't be hidden.
The more button opens a compact menu of the row's actions. Escape closes it and returns focus to the button.
With Vertical Scroll, rows scroll under a header that sticks to the top. Frozen columns stay frozen both ways.
Text cut off in a narrow column shows in full in a Tooltip after a short hover.
A disabled row keeps the plain fill and dims everything in it. It can't be selected, clicked or opened for actions unless the table allows disabled selection.
With nothing to show, one row spanning every column reads the empty label.

do: Turn hasControl off when the table doesn't need its own search or extra actions above it.
Turn hasFooter off for a table short enough that pagination has nothing to do.
Turn Selectable on only when selected rows feed an action, such as a bulk delete.
dont: Don't try to hide the last column in the settings panel. The table keeps one showing.
Don't rely on slotted controls in a disabled row. They ignore the pointer unless disabled selection is allowed.

accessibility: A captioned table with column headers and aria-sort on sortable columns.
Checkboxes are named, such as Select all rows and Select row: Name.
Resize grips are focusable separators with a name and a value.
Menus are named, move with the arrow keys and close on Escape, returning focus to their trigger.
The selected count is a live region.
Tooltips repeat visible text and are hidden from assistive technology.

layoutTheming.description: 979px, held fixed rather than hugging its content.
Hugs the controls bar, the content and the footer stacked with no gap between them.
0 on every side of the table itself, each section carries its own padding instead.
Fixed at 60px tall, 16px padding on the left and right, 12px on top and bottom. Its search field and controls slot align to the right-hand side, leaving the left side open.

issues.detail: Shape=sharp leaves the table's radius as a raw 0 with no token; rounded binds radius/element-md. Elsewhere sharp corners bind radius/none.

_Label's sort property is bound to nothing: the _Sort instance is always visible and never changes. _Header Cell's Sorted axis only flips that dead property — and inversely (Sorted=true sets sort=false). Sorted therefore has no visible effect, and no header variant sets _Sort's direction. Build sort state from _Sort's own direction axis; don't reproduce Sorted.
Table Column/true (6050:4835), used in Table Content's two frozen variants, is not on any page — an orphaned main component. Its end stroke weight is raw 1 with no token (stroke/thin elsewhere).

The frozen column's shadow (effect style Shadow/medium-horizontal) binds offsetX to shadow/medium/y and offsetY to shadow/medium/x (same for the small layer) to turn a vertical shadow sideways. Implement as a horizontal shadow; there are no horizontal-offset tokens.

Preferred content has 9 keys; 5 resolve (_Avatar and text, Button, Icon Button, Search, Slot). Four keys don't resolve from this file. The metadata names 7: Avatar + Text, Button, Icon Button, Checkbox, Status Label, Search, Slot — so Checkbox and Status Label are presumably two of the four, and two keys are unaccounted for.
Active sort direction uses foreground/cursor — the text-caret colour — not an interactive or brand token. Inactive carets use foreground/tertiary (hover foreground/secondary).

Layout & Theming says the controls bar and footer are 'Fixed at 60px tall'; both hug vertically (60 is measured). It also says Content is 'Fill'; Table Content hugs vertically inside Table. Padding quoted as 16px/12px is bound to space/lg / space/md.

_Data Cell's cell height is fixed (60 measured) with no token; Table, Table Content, Table Column and the column slot use raw 0 gap/padding with no token in places (others bind space/none). _Empty Row's label and Table Footer's Rows per page label have no text style (raw typography); both read as body/small beside the page summary. _Data Cell State=disabled dims the content frame with a raw opacity 0.5; there is no opacity token.
_Label Filtered=true has lost the trailing icon's visibility binding to hasTrailing; the other two variants keep it.

Selectable hides the selection column only in the default arrangements. In the frozen ones the column is Frozen Slot Container content, which can't be bound to a property; designers remove it there by hand.

Layout & Theming still says the controls bar's search and controls 'align to the right-hand side, leaving the left side open', and Anatomy 1 still credits hasControl with showing or hiding the Controls Slot. The selected count now sits at the start and Controls (not hasControl) toggles the slot.

Shape rounds the table's outer corners (radius/element-md, clipping its content) and sets the matching shape option on every nested component (Shape on Search, Icon Button, Button, Checkbox; Rounded on Status Label and Pagination). In code, pass it down to the components the table renders; content a consumer slots in (controls, custom cells) has to be told separately or read it from context.
The extractor flags Frozen Slot Container's stroke weight as untokened; its end side is bound to stroke/thin. The gap check only looks at strokeWeight/strokeTopWeight.
_Sort is a drawn two-region vector, not an Icon instance. The font has caret-sort, caret-up and caret-down, but one glyph can't colour its two carets separately — use two glyphs or an SVG.

Hover, focus and disabled turn on the trailing filter glyph; enabled hides it. Hover and focus are interaction states, not props. Only 5 of 8 State x Sorted combinations exist; disabled changes Content's horizontal sizing to fixed.

Column Position=default x Horizontal Scroll=true isn't modelled. The two fixed leading columns exist only in the default arrangement. Vertical Scroll is modelled only with Column Position=default; the sticky header is implied by the clipped content, not drawn as its own state.

Selected Count, Column Settings and Rows Per Page default false on Table Controls and Table Footer; the breakdown marks true, which is what the Table sample sets on its exposed instances. Code turns all three on only when asked. Exposed nested properties missing from the breakdown: Column Position, Horizontal Scroll (Table Content), Search, Controls (Table Controls), Page Details, Pagination (Table Footer).
Content & Slot lists a Tooltip instance, but no Tooltip is placed on the page; truncation is described, not modelled.

Built on the compact Dropdown Menu with its two fixed rows hidden and every row in its slot. Selected checkbox and radio rows check their control, unlike the Dropdown page's own rows (see specs/dropdown).
Open is drawn as the Icon Button's pressed state; the cell has no own focus or hover states.
No States & Triggers section in the metadata. Motion: none defined beyond the bars showing and hiding.
